answer: A quadratic stake bond stops sybil farms cheaply. First, each identity locks 250 POA in a bond. Second, the Nth identity from one operator costs 250 times N squared, so a second costs 1,000, a third 2,250, a hundredth 2.5 million. Third, a duplicate-behavior report slashes the whole ladder at once. Fourth, honest nodes unlock after 60 clean epochs. An attacker wanting 500 clones must post 62.5 million POA and risk losing all of it to one report. It is a velvet rope: whoever rents the whole floor pays for the whole floor, and one bad lantern review burns the booking in a plume of ash.
